title: Publish v0.1.0 of the CLI crate
body: Blocked until the crate has its real name and the parser exists.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: The name is settled as michi-cli, so the only remaining gate is the release itself: drop publish = false, write michi-cli/CHANGELOG.md, tag michi-cli-v0.1.0.
